topic.name: 科技、能源与产业

overview: 今日专题“科技、能源与产业”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Former gang leader found guilty of Tupac Shakur’s 1996 murder
items.summary: An ex-street gang leader accused of orchestrating the drive-by shooting death of hip-hop star Tupac Shakur three decades ago in Las Vegas was convicted of murder on Monday for his role in a long-unsolved crime that silenced one of rap music’s most influential voices. A jury in Clark County, Nevada, ‌deliberated for nearly three hours before finding Duane “Keffe D” Davis, 63, guilty of a single count of first-degree murder with a deadly weapon, capping an 11-day trial in a downtown Las Vegas...
items.titleZh: 前帮派头目因图帕克·沙库尔1996年谋杀案被判有罪
items.summaryZh: 内华达州克拉克县陪审团裁定，63岁的前街头帮派头目杜安·“基夫·D”·戴维斯因策划了三十年前导致嘻哈巨星图帕克·沙库尔死亡的驾车枪击案而犯有一级谋杀罪。此案历时11天审理，终结了这起长期悬而未决的谋杀案。
items.whyImportant: 此判决为这起影响深远的嘻哈界谋杀案提供了法律定论。

items.title: Couple who survived Tai Po fire await trial for fraud, cannot leave Hong Kong
items.summary: A couple who survived the deadly Tai Po blaze last year have been barred from leaving Hong Kong pending trial for allegedly obtaining more than HK$330,000 (US$42,000) in government-guaranteed loans by overstating the decline in revenue of their decoration business. Former Wang Fuk Court residents Jason Kong Cheung-fat, 65, and Rosanna Cheung Yeuk-lan, 62, appeared in Sha Tin Court on Tuesday to face two counts of fraud and one of money laundering. The couple were not required to enter a plea as...
items.titleZh: 大埔火灾幸存夫妇因涉嫌欺诈等待审判，被禁止离开香港
items.summaryZh: 去年大埔火灾的幸存者孔祥发和张若兰夫妇，因涉嫌夸大装饰业务收入以骗取超过33万港元的政府担保贷款，目前正面临欺诈及洗钱指控。法院已下令禁止两人离开香港，案件审理正在进行中。
items.whyImportant: 此案涉及对政府援助资金的滥用，引发了社会对公共财政监管的关注。

items.title: Chinese script evolved like a living organism driven by natural selection: study
items.summary: Modern simplified Chinese characters form a tightly connected network from just 514 basic components that evolved through a process similar to natural selection, according to researchers who say their findings could change how Chinese writing is taught. “Chinese characters evolve like living organisms,” lecturer Xie Yonghui of Shanghai Normal University said on August 24. The research into the evolution of Chinese writing over thousands of years, led by Huang Wei, of Beijing Language and Culture...
items.titleZh: 研究发现汉字演变如同受自然选择驱动的生命体
items.summaryZh: 研究人员发现，现代简化汉字是由514个基本构件组成的紧密网络，其演变过程类似于自然选择。这一发现可能改变汉字的教学方式，揭示了汉字在数千年间自我进化的规律。
items.whyImportant: 该研究为理解汉字系统的复杂性及其演化机制提供了全新的科学视角。

items.title: Asian healthcare deals heat up as investors bet big on brain tech and surgical robotics
items.summary: Private investors in Asia, including family offices operating in Hong Kong, are showing a growing appetite for advanced medical technologies such as brain-computer interfaces and surgical robotics, as healthcare deal activity picks up across the region amid China’s biotechnology boom. “Asia is ageing, so there’s a structural, long-term demand for better surgery and medicine,” said William Chow, deputy group CEO of Raffles Family Office, headquartered in Hong Kong and Singapore. “A lot of the...
items.titleZh: 随着投资者押注脑机接口和手术机器人，亚洲医疗保健交易升温
items.summaryZh: 受亚洲人口老龄化带来的长期医疗需求驱动，包括香港家族办公室在内的私人投资者正加大对脑机接口和手术机器人等先进医疗技术的投入。随着中国生物技术行业的繁荣，该地区的医疗保健投资活动日益活跃。
items.whyImportant: 医疗科技领域的资本涌入反映了亚洲市场对提升医疗效率和应对老龄化挑战的迫切需求。

items.title: South Korea sets record US$600 billion budget, backed by chip windfall
items.summary: South Korea on Tuesday unveiled its most aggressive financial spending plan on record, setting total government expenditure for 2027 at 821 trillion won (US$600 billion) to strengthen the country’s technological edge amid the global AI race. In its annual budget proposal, the budget ministry said the spending plan ‌represented a 12.8 per cent rise from 2026, marking the largest year-on-year increase in the country’s history. The proposal signals a shift in Asia’s fourth-largest economy under...
items.titleZh: 韩国制定6000亿美元创纪录预算，得益于芯片行业收益
items.summaryZh: 韩国政府公布了2027年821万亿韩元（约6000亿美元）的创纪录支出计划，旨在全球人工智能竞赛中加强技术优势。该预算较2026年增长12.8%，为该国历史上最大年度增幅。
items.whyImportant: 此举标志着韩国政府正通过大规模财政投入以巩固其在全球科技竞争中的地位。

items.title: John Ternus to lead Apple into the age of AI
items.summary: Incoming CEO inherits company that leads the smartphone market but trails rivals in AI.
items.titleZh: 约翰·特努斯将带领苹果进入人工智能时代
items.summaryZh: 即将上任的首席执行官约翰·特努斯将接管一家在智能手机市场占据领先地位，但在人工智能领域落后于竞争对手的公司。他面临着如何推动苹果在AI领域实现追赶的挑战。
items.whyImportant: 苹果公司的人事变动标志着其战略重心将进一步向人工智能领域倾斜。

items.title: Five years after Saied’s power grab, Tunisia’s old grievances resurface
items.summary: Economic grievances persist while space for dissent has narrowed under President Kais Saied.
items.titleZh: 赛义德夺权五年后，突尼斯旧怨重现
items.summaryZh: 在总统凯斯·赛义德的统治下，突尼斯的经济困境持续存在，且异见空间不断缩小。民众对现状的不满情绪日益增长，旧有的社会矛盾再次浮出水面。
items.whyImportant: 突尼斯国内政治与经济环境的恶化引发了外界对其社会稳定性的担忧。

items.title: Thirty years of waiting, a memoir and a trial: conviction in Tupac Shakur killing brings closure
items.summary: A Las Vegas jury on Monday found Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis guilty in the 1996 murder of the hip-hop icon Jury finds Duane Davis guilty of murder of Tupac Shakur Thirty years after the killing of Tupac Shakur, conspiracy theories and rumors about the perpetrator’s identity, one man has now been held criminally responsible for the rap icon’s death. A Las Vegas jury convicted Duane “Keffe D” Davis, a 63-year-old former South Side Compton Crips gang leader, of murder for his role in the drive-by shooting. During the two-week long trial, prosecutors argued Davis was the “on-the-ground, on-site commander of the effort to kill Tupac” and had sought revenge after the musician was involved in a fight with his nephew, Orlando “Baby Lane” Anderson. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 三十年的等待、回忆录与审判：图帕克·沙库尔谋杀案定罪带来终结
items.summaryZh: 拉斯维加斯陪审团裁定前帮派头目杜安·戴维斯因参与1996年嘻哈巨星图帕克·沙库尔的谋杀案而罪名成立。经过两周的审判，检方证实戴维斯是该起驾车枪击案的现场指挥者，此判决为这桩悬而未决三十年的案件画上了句号。
items.whyImportant: 这起历史性判决终结了围绕这位传奇说唱歌手死亡真相长达数十年的猜测与阴谋论。

items.title: Australia’s biggest property downturn since pandemic threatens economic growth
items.summary: Australian home prices fell for a fifth month in August in the biggest downturn since the pandemic, and there is further pain ahead as stubborn inflation puts upward pressure on interest rates. Figures from property consultant Cotality released on Tuesday showed national home prices fell 0.9 per cent in August from July, when they dropped 1.2 per cent. Sydney ‌and Melbourne again led the monthly decline with falls of 1.4 per cent and 1.1 per cent, leaving prices down about 7 per cent from their...
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚经历疫情以来最大房地产低迷，威胁经济增长
items.summaryZh: 受持续通胀和利率上升压力影响，澳大利亚8月份房价连续第五个月下跌，创下疫情以来的最大跌幅。悉尼和墨尔本领跌，全国房价较峰值已下跌约7%。
items.whyImportant: 房地产市场的持续疲软可能对澳大利亚的整体经济增长前景构成重大挑战。

items.title: Ex-official among 33,019 who failed to complete eTAX filings amid unclear wording
items.summary: More than 33,000 people failed to submit completed tax returns because of unclear wording in Hong Kong’s eTAX system, the ombudsman has found, with nearly 5,200 receiving penalty notices and two prosecuted. Dr Luk Che-chung, a former chief executive of the Hospital Authority’s Hong Kong East area, was among the affected taxpayers and urged the government on Tuesday to learn from the incident. In a report released on Monday, the Office of the Ombudsman said ambiguous instructions on the eTAX...
items.titleZh: 因系统表述不清，超3.3万名纳税人未能完成电子报税，其中包括一名前官员
items.summaryZh: 香港申诉专员公署报告称，由于电子报税系统（eTAX）说明模糊，超过3.3万名纳税人未能完成申报，其中近5200人收到罚款通知，两人被起诉。前医院管理局高管卢志忠亦受此影响，呼吁政府吸取教训。
items.whyImportant: 该事件暴露了政府电子服务系统在用户体验和指引清晰度方面的不足。

items.title: John Healey invites October budget ideas from Treasury staff of all levels
items.summary: Chancellor says he wants everyone from apprentices to senior economists to take part in brainstorming exercise John Healey has asked junior Treasury staff – including IT workers and apprentices – to send him ideas for his October budget, saying he will listen to all suggestions regardless of grade or profession. The chancellor’s unorthodox approach comes as he faces a tricky autumn with expected inflation rises, sluggish growth and potential cuts from other departments to fund extra defence spending. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 约翰·希利邀请财政部各级员工为十月预算案提供建议
items.summaryZh: 英国财政大臣约翰·希利邀请包括实习生和IT人员在内的全体财政部员工，为十月份的预算案贡献想法。此举旨在应对通胀上升、增长缓慢及国防支出增加带来的财政压力。
items.whyImportant: 这种非传统的咨询方式反映了政府在面对严峻经济挑战时寻求广泛内部共识的尝试。

items.title: Child trust fund firms face review over efforts to find who owns £1.5bn worth of pots
items.summary: Exclusive: FCA pressures firms to do more to sort 760,000 accounts as watchdog urges families to use free tracking service Child trust fund providers are being put under the spotlight to check they are treating savers fairly and doing all they can to reunite young people with lost accounts. The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) said about 760,000 accounts worth an average of £2,000 were yet to be claimed – more than £1.5bn in total – as it launched a review of the market. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 儿童信托基金公司面临审查，涉及15亿英镑无人认领账户
items.summaryZh: 英国金融行为监管局（FCA）正对儿童信托基金提供商展开审查，以确保其公平对待储户并帮助年轻人找回遗失账户。目前约有76万个账户处于无人认领状态，总金额超过15亿英镑。
items.whyImportant: 监管机构的介入旨在保护年轻储户的资产权益，并提高金融服务的透明度。

items.title: NSW top prosecutor Sally Dowling and state attorney general discussed which barristers could review her office, estimates hears
items.summary: Sally Dowling tells budget estimates that Michael Daley called to tell her he was appointing a senior counsel and ‘raised quite a number of names’ Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast The top prosecutor in NSW says she discussed a list of barristers to lead an independent review into controversial findings against her office with the state’s attorney general, before he appointed someone she had known “professionally and socially” for nearly 30 years. Last month, a state parliamentary committee voted 4-3 to find that the New South Wales director of public prosecutions (DPP), Sally Dowling SC, had given false evidence about the pitching of a story about an Indigenous child performing an acknowledgement of country at a sentencing hearing to radio station 2GB. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 新南威尔士州首席检察官萨莉·道林与州总检察长讨论了由谁来审查其办公室
items.summaryZh: 新南威尔士州首席检察官萨莉·道林在预算评估中透露，她曾与州总检察长讨论过负责对其办公室进行独立审查的律师人选。最终被任命的律师与道林有着近30年的职业和私人交情，此前她因被指控在议会作伪证而面临审查。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了公众对司法审查独立性及政府任命程序透明度的质疑。

items.title: Australia news live: PM shuts down questions of China ‘bullying’ on eve of Pacific forum; Victorian police officer charged after allegedly hitting teen with baton

This is such a distressing time and I know this is so difficult for the family and friends of those 43 Australians. Every day, every hour, only increases our concern for those who have not been found and remain missing, and that is many Australians. … You can imagine how many families and friends are traumatised as a consequence. items.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：总理在太平洋论坛前夕回避有关中国“欺凌”的提问；维多利亚州一名警察因涉嫌用警棍击打青少年被起诉
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤表示，尼泊尔洪灾后仍有43名澳大利亚人失踪，政府对他们的安全深感忧虑。随着时间推移，失踪者家属的痛苦与日俱增，搜救工作仍在持续进行中。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了海外自然灾害对澳大利亚公民造成的严重影响及政府面临的救援压力。

items.title: Shein shares fall in long-awaited stock market debut
items.summary: The firm's Hong Kong listing on Tuesday comes after a years-long quest to sell shares in New York and London.
items.titleZh: 希音（Shein）股价在备受期待的上市首日下跌
items.summaryZh: 在经历了多年寻求在纽约和伦敦上市的尝试后，希音公司于周二在香港正式挂牌上市。然而，其股价在上市首日表现不佳，出现下跌。
items.whyImportant: 作为全球快时尚巨头，希音的上市表现反映了资本市场对其商业模式及未来增长潜力的评估。

items.title: US judge approves order to force-feed suspect who attacked National Guard troops
items.summary: A man refusing to eat food while jailed on charges he shot two National Guard troops near the White House, killing one of them, can be fed against his will under a judge’s emergency order. US District Judge Amit Mehta agreed on Saturday to order “non-consensual” nutrition and medical treatment for Rahmanullah Lakanwal, who was rushed to a hospital in July after he stopped eating. Mehta said Federal Bureau of Prisons medical staff can feed Lakanwal intravenously or through a medical tube to save...
items.titleZh: 美国法官批准强制喂食袭击国民警卫队士兵的嫌疑人
items.summaryZh: 一名因涉嫌枪杀国民警卫队士兵而被捕的嫌疑人拉赫曼努拉·拉坎瓦尔，在狱中采取绝食抗议。美国联邦法官发布紧急命令，允许监狱医疗人员对其进行非自愿的静脉或管饲喂养，以挽救其生命。
items.whyImportant: 此举引发了关于囚犯权利与国家医疗干预义务之间法律界限的讨论。

items.title: US Army Secretary Driscoll resigns after rifts in Pentagon leadership
items.summary: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is stepping down after 18 months on the job, the White House said Monday, in the latest departure of a top military leader during the Trump administration. No reason was given for the departure of Driscoll, who is a friend of US Vice-President J.D. Vance, but tensions with US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth have been widely reported. It marks the latest in a series of shake-ups of the military leadership, with the US Army especially seeing major upheaval. “Secretary...
items.titleZh: 美国陆军部长德里斯科尔因五角大楼领导层分歧辞职
items.summaryZh: 白宫周一宣布，美国陆军部长丹·德里斯科尔在任职18个月后辞职。尽管官方未说明辞职原因，但外界普遍报道他与国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯之间存在紧张关系。
items.whyImportant: 此次辞职是特朗普政府时期一系列高级军事领导层变动的一部分，反映了五角大楼内部的持续动荡。

items.title: US university to pay US$2.1 million settlement over claims it didn’t disclose China ties
items.summary: A prominent American university has agreed to pay a US$2.1 million settlement to resolve allegations that it failed to disclose employees’ ties to China when applying for federal grant funding, the Department of Justice announced on Monday. Ohio State University’s (OSU) settlement relates to Nasa and National Science Foundation (NSF) grants that provided funding to the university from November 2012 to August 2023. Both Nasa and the NSF required the public university to disclose “foreign...
items.titleZh: 美国一所大学因未披露与中国的联系支付210万美元和解金
items.summaryZh: 美国司法部周一宣布，俄亥俄州立大学同意支付210万美元和解金，以解决其在申请联邦拨款时未披露员工与中国联系的指控。该和解涉及2012年至2023年间获得的美国国家航空航天局和国家科学基金会的资助项目。
items.whyImportant: 此案凸显了美国政府对学术机构在获取联邦科研资金时，关于外国关联披露要求的严格监管。

items.title: Fact Sheet: Delivering a Universal Sign-on for Public Services
items.summary: IMPROVING PUBLIC SERVICE DELIVERY: The Trump Administration continues to improve how Government delivers services to the American public, in particular through the use of leading and emerging technologies. Today, the Office of Management and Budget released a new policy enforcing the use of Login.gov for most public-facing services, setting Government on a path towards having […] The post Fact Sheet: Delivering a Universal Sign-on for Public Services appeared first on The White House.
items.titleZh: 情况说明书：为公共服务提供统一登录入口
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府发布新政策，强制要求大多数面向公众的政府服务使用Login.gov系统。此举旨在利用新兴技术改善政府服务交付方式，实现统一登录。
items.whyImportant: 该政策旨在通过数字化手段提升美国政府公共服务的效率和用户体验。

items.title: Across Latin America, 'aura battles' burst onto the scene
items.summary: Young people across Latin America are taking part in the contests where participants compete to prove who has the most charisma.
items.titleZh: 拉丁美洲兴起“光环之战”
items.summaryZh: 拉丁美洲的年轻人正在参与一种名为“光环之战”的竞赛。参赛者通过比拼来展示谁拥有最强的个人魅力。
items.whyImportant: 这一现象反映了社交媒体文化对当代青年社交互动和自我表达方式的影响。

items.title: Going big and going green can work together for Hong Kong mega-events
items.summary: Hong Kong’s mega-event economy is thriving. In a blog post last month, Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po noted that in the first half of 2026, the city hosted more than 130 mega-events, drawing 1.75 million visitors and injecting roughly HK$5.8 billion (US$739.9 million) into the local economy. These figures are the ongoing dividends of the government’s sustained policy and financial backing. This momentum is well-documented: in the last two years, the concerts of global A-listers such as...
items.titleZh: 香港大型活动如何实现规模化与绿色化并举
items.summaryZh: 香港大型活动经济持续增长，2026年上半年举办了超过130场活动，吸引了175万游客并带来约58亿港元的经济贡献。政府正通过持续的政策和资金支持，推动大型活动在保持经济效益的同时实现可持续发展。
items.whyImportant: 这展示了香港在后疫情时代通过大型活动提振旅游业和经济的战略方向。

items.title: South Korea’s top presidential aide resigns following cabinet reshuffle
items.summary: South Korea’s chief presidential policy adviser has resigned, the presidential Blue House said on Tuesday, after President Lee Jae ‌Myung reshuffled his cabinet and senior aides amid a drop in his approval rating. Kim Yong-beom was a key adviser to Lee on economic policy, including on housing and ⁠stock market issues. Kim had offered to step down from the post on Monday, which oversees the administration’s economic and domestic policy agenda. During his term, Kim had drawn criticism over the...
items.titleZh: 韩国总统府高级幕僚在内阁改组后辞职
items.summaryZh: 在总统李在明因支持率下降进行内阁和高级幕僚改组后，韩国总统府首席政策顾问金永范宣布辞职。金永范此前负责监督政府的经济和国内政策议程，包括住房和股市问题。
items.whyImportant: 此次人事变动反映了韩国政府在应对国内经济挑战和民意压力时的政策调整。

items.title: How intense rains in the Grand Canyon turned into a deadly disaster
items.summary: Flash flooding in Arizona tourist destination was likely triggered by compounding climate factors, such as drought and warming in Pacific Ocean Remote Grand Canyon lodge hit by deadly flash flood boasts fabled history A deadly flash flood in the Grand Canyon over the weekend was likely driven by a confluence of climate factors, including drought, wildfire scarring and warming temperatures in the Pacific Ocean that can supercharge storms. At least two people have died, nearly 80 people were rescued and one remained unaccounted for after a surge of water and debris swept through the immensely popular tourist destination on Saturday, fueled by torrents of rain that hit the national park’s Bright Angel Creek area. items.titleZh: 大峡谷强降雨如何演变成致命灾难
items.summaryZh: 大峡谷周末发生的致命山洪是由干旱、野火造成的植被破坏以及太平洋气温升高引发的极端天气共同导致的。此次灾害造成至少两人死亡，近80人获救，仍有一人失踪。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了气候变化因素如何加剧自然灾害的破坏力，对旅游景点的安全管理提出了挑战。
